---
name: code-review
description: Review code changes for correctness, style, and potential issues.
---

Review the staged changes or specified files for:

1. Correctness: logic errors, off-by-one, null handling
2. Style: naming conventions, formatting consistency
3. Performance: unnecessary allocations, N+1 queries
4. Security: input validation, injection risks

Report findings grouped by severity (error, warning, info).
